description: This file contains a client API for interacting with a product inventory system, including functions to fetch, create, update, delete products, and manage product images. It defines an ApiError class, utility functions for API base URL handling, and a ProductsAPI object with methods for CRUD operations.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: Custom Error subclass representing API related errors, including HTTP status and response body.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL from environment variables or defaults to an empty string, removing trailing slashes for consistency.

methods.name: apiFetch(path, options = {})
methods.description: A wrapper around the fetch API that handles JSON responses, error normalization, and includes headers handling.

methods.name: list({ q, limit = 100, offset = 0 } = {})
methods.description: Lists products with optional search query, limit, and offset for pagination.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a single product by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new product with the provided payload.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing product identified by ID with the provided payload.

methods.name: uploadImage
methods.description: Uploads or replaces an image for a specific product.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Deletes the image associated with a specific product.
